name: Fake MEMEPAD (MEMEPAD)
rootCause: Fake MEMEPAD (MEMEPAD) on ETH is suspected of a rug pull, with the deployer removing substantial liquidity, causing a 100% price decline.

descriptions.text: Fake MEMEPAD (MEMEPAD) on ETH is suspected of a rug pull, with the deployer removing substantial liquidity, causing a 100% price decline.

Publicly available evidence does not establish a distinct October 2023 Ethereum incident involving a specific MEME token contract and a verified $188,000 loss. The available reporting instead describes broader meme-token rug-pull activity and generic liquidity-removal scams, without recoverable transaction hashes or contract attribution for this database entry. The currently available evidence does not support a smart contract exploit or logic flaw. The limited reporting resembles a deployer-controlled liquidity-removal rug pull, but no specific MEME token contract, liquidity pool, deployer wallet, or exploit transaction has been independently established.
